For shader and graphics programming: I liked this tutorial series as a "first steps" by Freya Holmér: [VIDEO] Here is another list: [LINK] The Book of Shaders is a popular suggestion, but it appears to be abandoned: [LINK] For general Unreal? Tom Looman's $300 Unreal C++ class, available on his website. It is pricey but really excellent. I also discovered this AWESOME list of learning paths for all gamedev concepts: [LINK]
